text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To address safety concerns and congestion in the area of Weston Collegiate Institute (100 Pine Street), it is recommended that a school bus loading zone be relocated to accommodate school buses loading and discharging students. In addition, the existing parking regulations will be adjusted to reflect the relocation of the School Bus Loading Zone. These amendments will improve traffic operations, address concerns regarding traffic congestion and safety and provide additional facilities for school drop-off and pick-up of attending school children. These recommendations are the result of consultation with the area Councillor, the school's principal, and a public meeting.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing school bus loading zone in operation from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on the north side of MacDonald Avenue, between a point 15 metres west of Pine Street and a point 54 metres further west. 2. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of MacDonald Avenue, between Springmount Avenue and Pine Street. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition at all times on the west side of Pine Street, between MacDonald Avenue and a point 67 metres south of William Street. 4. Rescinded the existing stopping prohibition at all times on the west side of Pine Street, between a point 67 metres south of William Street and William Street. 5.
